narrative.synopsis: Cronus uses Gaia’s sickle to ambush Uranus when the sky descends over the earth. The violent overthrow frees Gaia from Uranus’ immediate domination and begins the Titan phase of cosmic rule.
narrative.openingSituation: Gaia’s revolt has a weapon and a willing son.
narrative.centralConflict: Cronus must strike the seemingly untouchable sky father at the moment he covers Gaia.
narrative.resolution: Uranus is wounded and displaced by his son.
narrative.outcome: Cronus gains power, but the method of succession makes later retaliation inevitable.
